properties: Exact canonical encoded JSON bytes are reconstructed and hashed; no scientific numeric types are restored.
Stream compression to bounded SQLite chunks, one FULL synchronous transaction per complete record.
Every occurrence has its own immutable record; evaluated data from A24/A48/B50 is never deduplicated across routes.
Original files are refused for writing; no automatic resume or migration.
Partial transaction failures preserve earlier committed records; full payload and external chain receipts detect corruption and suffix truncation.
Namespace descriptors are exact byte identities, not scientific proof of complete request semantics or cache reuse.
tested: Encoded MP-shaped synthetic data, signed zero, Unicode, large synthetic payloads and exact JSON byte comparison.
Duplicate record refusals, independent namespace/settings identity, unknown keys/types and nonfinite rejection.
Rollback on a serialization failure after a large prefix, corruption/truncated/reordered chunks, envelope/namespace tampering, externally pinned chain tail.
notEstablished: No native compression ratio, capacity, throughput or RSS estimate.
The encoder may materialize a large string and the original object remains live; worker resource containment and record design are still required.
No kill/power-loss recovery rehearsal, database migration or automatic recovery implementation.
No numerical cache, interning of values, quadrature change, interpolation, node omission or compacted accepted evidence.
Future guarded evaluator integration and independent concrete build assessment are required before scientific use.
